$comment: The five diseases (SD027 §4.6), set independently of protection type: construction's loss taxonomy, in the order published research says each costs a contractor, most first. Keys are the vocabulary of obligations/*.yaml's `disease` and are the keys Demiton stores and shows. Demiton's own measure names (`claim_window`, `evidence_gap`, `compliance_gate`, `rework_signal`, `overrun_signal`) are an implementation detail on the other side of this repository's boundary. `start` is what a disease's daily check needs before it can run: a list of groups, ALL of which must hold data, where ANY one register in a group is enough. `feeders` are the registers that enrich a verdict. `buyer_name`, `what` and `prevention` are the brand standard's Section 1 copy.

rework.label: Rework
rework.what: Work done twice: failed inspections, NCRs, wrong ground assumptions.
rework.prevention: The test result lands in the register before the pour goes wrong.

subcategories.label: Design and documentation
subcategories.covers: Wrong, late, incomplete or superseded design; clashes; unclear specification; an unanswered RFI.

subcategories.label: Scope and change
subcategories.covers: A requirement changed after work was committed: client or end-user change, variation, design change, a latent-condition instruction.

subcategories.label: Planning, procurement and sequencing
subcategories.covers: Wrong quantity or type bought, repeat orders, over-order, wrong method or sequence, temporary works, long-lead material.

subcategories.label: Setting-out, ground and external conditions
subcategories.covers: Wrong level or position, survey error, service strike, ground not as recorded, weather or external damage.

subcategories.label: Workmanship and quality conformance
subcategories.covers: Work not to specification: failed test, NCR, ITP or hold-point failure, non-conforming work, punch list, defective material installed.

overrun.label: Baseline overrun
overrun.what: Cost and programme drift against the tender.
overrun.prevention: The drift is caught at $50K, not $5M.

subcategories.label: Tender pricing
subcategories.covers: The estimate or schedule of rates was short from the start.

subcategories.label: Quantity growth
subcategories.covers: More was built than the schedule priced.

subcategories.label: Labour productivity and overstaffing
subcategories.covers: More hours than the work needed.

subcategories.label: Plant and fuel
subcategories.covers: Plant hours and fuel above what was priced.

subcategories.label: Input price rises
subcategories.covers: Materials and subcontract prices rising on a fixed price.

forfeited_entitlements.label: Forfeited entitlements
forfeited_entitlements.what: Variations and time owed but never claimed: notices missed, time bars closed, wet days never logged.
forfeited_entitlements.prevention: The notice is drafted before the window closes.

subcategories.label: Uncaptured
subcategories.covers: The event never reaches a register in a claimable form: no diary delay flag, no docket, no variation, no email issue. The clock never starts because there is nothing to time.

subcategories.label: Unnoticed
subcategories.covers: A trigger exists and the contract window is computed, but no notice is served by the due date, or the notice is late.

subcategories.label: Unquantified
subcategories.covers: The notice was served, but the claim carries no amount, no build-up and no supporting records. The window is covered; nothing is asked for.

subcategories.label: Under-claimed
subcategories.covers: A number exists but omits heads: prolongation, preliminaries, margin, escalation, off-hire, financing, disruption, head-office overhead.

subcategories.label: Uncollected
subcategories.covers: The entitlement was agreed or awarded but the cash never arrives: an approved variation unpaid, retention not released, a security not returned.

disputes.label: Disputes
disputes.what: The claim that became a case.
disputes.prevention: The record is complete before the argument starts.

subcategories.label: Unraised
subcategories.covers: The defence, set-off or counterclaim is never put, so the other side's claim stands by default. An entitlement you never claimed is forfeited, not this.

subcategories.label: Time-barred
subcategories.covers: The dispute dies on procedure: jurisdiction, a notice window, a payment schedule, an adjudication deadline.

subcategories.label: Unsupported
subcategories.covers: The claim or defence is on time but the contemporaneous record is missing: no diary, no photos, no notice, no cost build-up, no programme.

subcategories.label: Outargued
subcategories.covers: The evidence exists but the merits are weaker: contract interpretation, liability, causation, delay analysis, defects and set-off.

subcategories.label: Unrecovered
subcategories.covers: The dispute is won or settled but the cash never arrives: insolvency, enforcement, security, retention.

non_compliance.label: Non-compliance
non_compliance.what: The right to bid itself: panels, prequalification, certificates.
non_compliance.prevention: The expiry is counted down 90-30-7, before the panel notices.

subcategories.label: Unidentified
subcategories.covers: The requirement is not in the library or the applicability rules, so no gate exists. A permit the jurisdiction requires, a ticket class the contract names, a prequalification condition nobody captured.

subcategories.label: Unheld
subcategories.covers: The requirement is known but there is no record at all: no ticket, no policy, no registration. The engine cannot see absence because it reads records that exist.

subcategories.label: Lapsed
subcategories.covers: A record exists and is expired, or inside the 90/30/7 countdown.

subcategories.label: Out of scope
subcategories.covers: The record is current but does not cover the task, person, asset or place: wrong ticket class, wrong plant category, insurance territory or limit, prequalification scope.

subcategories.label: Unapplied
subcategories.covers: The record is valid and in scope, but the duty was not performed: a machine started without a prestart, a worker was not inducted, a permit condition was breached, a traffic plan was not followed.
